products.title: Adidas Hmx Pro Black Green 2026 - Adidas
products.description:
ADIDAS HMX PRO BLACK GREEN 2026 - The ADIDAS HMX PRO BLACK GREEN 2026 is a versatile racket, for the 2026 season. With an expanded sweet spot. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

We are pleased to present you the new ADIDAS HMX PRO BLACK GREEN 2026, a racket with a round format, very versatile and with superior control. This model is ideal for mastering each point.

PLAYER TYPE

The type of player for whom we recommend this racket is a dominant player, who wants to defend each ball and improve technique and precision. One of the most comfortable models of this season for all levels.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The ADIDAS HMX PRO BLACK GREEN 2026 is a round format racket, we want to highlight this as its main feature. This format offers us an extensive sweet spot, to help us with off-center hits so that the ball continues to come out well and with high precision.

It is a racket made of fiberglass both in frame and planes, which generates a much softer hitting sensation than a carbon racket. And if a soft EVA rubber is added to this, the touch will be very comfortable, with a soft feel for greater output and rebound.

products.title: Vibora Yarara Radical 12k 2.0 2025 - Vibor-a
products.description:
VIBORA YARARA RADICAL 12K 2.0 2025 - Elegance is the word that best sums up this racket. Black and silver aesthetic. Without a doubt, a racket with a great design but with better features and playability. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

If you are looking for the latest design and advanced technologies, the VIBORA YARARA RADICAL 12K 2.0 2025 is your next racket and match partner. It is an advanced model, in a hybrid form with which we will achieve a very balanced game.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for high levels. It is a racket with a medium-hard feel, so if you are a player who likes hard padel rackets, keep this model in mind, you will like it.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

In the features section, the Yarara Radical 12K stands out for the following:

Designed with a hybrid shape: it is the ideal mold to combine control and power. We have to say that it will give us a little more power in the blows.
Made entirely of 12K carbon: we will have more resistance and durability on the track.
Multi-density laminated EVA core: medium-hard feel and no vibrations.
Rough matte finish: improves ball control and precision.
Medium balance: easy to handle. It is a very comfortable racket in the hands.
Within the Radical line, one of the best from the Vibora Padel brand.

products.title: Paletero Siux Pulse Blue 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX PULSE BLUE 2026 PADEL BAG - Paddle bag with a capacity of 37 liters. It is ergonomic and therefore very comfortable for everyday use. This SIUX PULSE BLUE 2026 PADEL BAG model is designed to enjoy paddle tennis. If you are starting out and looking for good organization, without wanting a giant padel racket bag but with enough space to store all your material, this is an interesting option.

Its capacity of 37 liters and approximate dimensions of 56 × 29 × 24 cm will offer us the necessary space to transport our equipment, without excess space, but it is what an occasional player needs.

One of its strong points is comfort in transportation. It incorporates a top handle to carry it in your hand and two padded and adjustable handles, which allow it to be used as a backpack and easily adapted to each trip. Its lightweight structure makes it especially comfortable for short trips and frequent use.

The design maintains a simple and sporty line, with blue details that provide a modern and discreet touch.

products.title: Head Revolt Court 5.0 Men Black White - Head
products.description:
HEAD REVOLT COURT 5.0 MEN BLACK WHITE - Head's mid-range shoe, a model that highlights versatility for everyday use on the slopes. 

The HEAD REVOLT COURT 5.0 MEN BLACK WHITE are very versatile mid-range sneakers, comfortable and with personality under a classic design in black and white details, an aesthetic with which you will never go wrong.

This model is committed to lightness and comfort from the first use. The soft mesh upper wraps the foot with a flexible and breathable feel, while strategically placed PU reinforcements protect the areas that suffer the most on the court.

In the lower area, the cushioned EVA midsole absorbs impacts effectively and maintains a balanced footprint. The PU insole adds extra softness that is appreciated during prolonged training. It is not an exaggerated cushioning, but rather comfortable and stable, designed for those who play regularly but without professional demands.

What type of player are they recommended for?

For occasional players, committed beginners or athletes who train with moderate frequency and are looking for a comfortable, light shoe with a modern design.

It incorporates a single main compartment, but it is very spacious and allows you to easily organize products such as gel, deodorant, creams or small sports accessories.
